name: promo-showcase
title: Promo showcase
description: A feature showcase: one large frame and a row of chapters, each a clip that explains one thing. The bar fills while the clip plays and its end moves to the next chapter; hover, focus, a hidden tab or reduced motion hold it, and a failed or refused clip is timed like a still.
docs: Fill it from a card slot with <PromoShowcase slot="showcase" /> (each live card with media becomes a chapter; its eyebrow is the tab label), or pass chapters directly to <Showcase />. Media may carry silent clips (media.video).
